io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.utils.compatibility

Class PdcCompat

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.utils.compatibility.PdcCompat

  • public final class PdcCompat
extends java.lang.Object
    Java-8 universal port: a single, fully-reflective Persistent-Data (PDC) abstraction.

    PDC is 1.14+. Rather than referencing PersistentDataContainer/PersistentDataType/ PersistentDataHolder (1.14+ types) in core bytecode, every operation here is reflective and keyed by Slimefun's own NamespacedKey (converted to the real org.bukkit.NamespacedKey via BukkitKeys only at the call into the server). On servers without PDC (1.8–1.13) the container/type/key resolve to null and operations fall back per holder: item metas persist through real item NBT (NbtItemCompat), holders with a stable id (players/entities) through a YAML store, so callers are inherently version-safe. typeName is a PersistentDataType field name such as "STRING", "BYTE", "INTEGER", "LONG" or "FLOAT".
